title: ARE you weary, are you heavy hearted?

lines.text: ARE you weary, are you heavy hearted?
Tell Christ Jesus, tell Christ Jesus
Are you grieving over joys departed?
Tell Christ Jesus alone.
Tell Christ Jesus - 2ce
He is a friend so well known
You have no other such friend or brother
Tell Christ Jesus alone.
Do the tear flow down your
cheeks unbidden?
Tell Christ Jesus, tell Christ Jesus
Have you sins that to men’s eyes
are hidden.
Do you fear the gathering clouds
of sorrow
Tell Christ Jesus, tell Christ Jesus
Are you anxious what shall be
tomorrow?
Are you troubled at the thought of dying
Tell Christ Jesus, tell Christ Jesus
For Christ’s coming Kingdom are
you sighing?
